stem.en: A prism spreads white light into a rainbow of colours. Where did the different colours come from?
stem.et: Prisma laotab valge valguse värvide vikerkaareks. Kust erinevad värvid pärinevad?

label.en: They were already present in the white light; the prism separates them because each bends by a slightly different amount
label.et: Need olid valges valguses juba olemas; prisma eraldab need, sest kumbki murdub veidi erineval määral

label.en: The prism generates new colours by adding energy to the light passing through it
label.et: Prisma tekitab uusi värve, lisades läbivale valgusele energiat

label.en: The colours appear because every wavelength bends by exactly the same amount
label.et: Värvid ilmuvad, sest iga lainepikkus murdub täpselt sama palju

label.en: The prism's own material colour is transferred onto the light
label.et: Prisma enda materjali värv kandub valgusele üle
